item.title: ODU alumna reflects on fatal terror attack: 'Going to impact them for the rest of their lives'
item.description: When Ashley Denton's phone began lighting up with alerts about a shooting at her alma mater, the emotions hit immediately.

item.title: Sister Rosetta Tharpe, godmother of rock 'n' roll, once called Richmond home
item.description: Sister Rosetta Tharpe, who once lived in Richmond, shaped the sound of rock 'n' roll. Now, more than 50 years after her death, her legacy is finally getting its due.

item.title: Crime insider sources say man found shot dead
item.description: Crime Insider sources have told our Jon Burkett that there was a man found shot and killed in Petersburg. We have reached out to police and are working to confirm those details.
